description.value:
Usage drawn on a creature or object

This rune is often placed on chests and boxes to keep their contents from spoiling, even in the hottest of climates. The rune-bearer takes a –5-foot circumstance penalty to its Speeds and becomes so cold that movement becomes dangerous; if the bearer takes a move action, it becomes @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} until the beginning of its next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-runesmith-assistant.pf2e-runesmith-assistant-items.Item.1QR428ABkNdyrZXd]{Effect: Lyskel, Rune of Frost}

Invocation The rune-bearer takes @Damage[ceil(@actor.level / 2)d4[cold]] damage, with a @Check[fortitude|basic|against:runesmith] save. All squares on the ground in the bearer's space and adjacent squares are covered in snow, becoming difficult terrain for 1 round.

Level (+2) The damage of the invocation increases by [[/r 1d4]].
